title: Submission deadlines.
officialText:
Except as otherwise provided in section 28-305.4.6, the registered design professional shall submit a written report to the commissioner within 60 days of completing the assessment, but not more than five years following submission of the preceding report of assessment, certifying the results of the assessment.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
